name: jQuery
fix: Upgrade to a current jQuery 3.7 release, or remove jQuery if the template no longer needs it. Versions before 3.5.0 are affected by published cross-site scripting issues (CVE-2020-11022 and CVE-2020-11023). If a shared template provides it, ask the host to upgrade it.

name: jQuery UI
fix: Upgrade jQuery UI to 1.13.2 or later, or remove it if it is unused. If a shared template provides it, ask the host to upgrade it.

name: Bootstrap
fix: Upgrade Bootstrap to a current 5.3 release. Bootstrap 3 is out of support. If a shared template provides it, ask the host to upgrade it.

name: AngularJS
fix: AngularJS 1.x is end of life. Plan a replacement with the team that owns the template. Do not stay on 1.x.

name: Lodash
fix: Upgrade Lodash to 4.17.21 or later. Older 4.x releases have published prototype-pollution issues.

name: Moment.js
fix: Moment.js is unmaintained. Prefer the platform's current date tools when the template is next rebuilt. This is not an emergency on its own.

name: Handlebars
fix: Upgrade Handlebars to 4.7.8 or later. Older releases have published template-injection issues.

name: Underscore
fix: Upgrade Underscore to 1.13.6 or later, or remove it if it is unused.

name: CKEditor 4
fix: CKEditor 4 is end of life. Ask the platform team about a supported editor before the next template change.

name: DOMPurify
fix: Upgrade DOMPurify to a current 3.x release. Check the project's security notes when you do.
